0022600023.text: The Lakers (4-1, first in the Pacific and third in the West) visit the Warriors (2-3, second in the Pacific and 10th in the West) in West Group C of the Emirates NBA Cup, Los Angeles' sixth game of the season, with the Lakers on a one-game win streak and Golden State on two straight wins. Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), and Gui Santos (knee tendinitis) is day-to-day, while Los Angeles is missing Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Cameron Carr (oblique strain) and Ziaire Williams is day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision. The Lakers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 127-105 win in Los Angeles on October 21, and they won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
